note: Question specifications for protocol v3, written after the v3 system (53dbec6) and the v3 corpus generator. Sizes were fixed before any run: per category 8 dev and 20 holdout questions. Targets (records, subjects) are drawn with a seed; expected answers come from the generator's recorded facts and labels only. The *_missing categories reuse the phrasings of the matching *_lookup categories, so answerability depends on the evidence, not on the wording.
